summary: Tested live backend and frontend fitness flows. API root, assistant streaming/validation, dashboard, libraries, exercise detail camera fallback, assistant, and mobile layout behaved as expected.

seed_data_creation: None; only local catalog content was viewed.

test_credentials: No credentials available in /app/memory/test_credentials.md; no auth account was created or modified.
rca of the issue: No confirmed product defect. Two initial browser findings were test-state/assumption issues: searching Tree (a subtitle) correctly returns no name match, and route navigation retained an unexpected input value during a combined script; direct route loads passed.
